items.title: Kering Q3 revenue stable as jewelry and eyewear offset Gucci contraction
items.summary: Gucci Q3 revenue EUR1.29bn, down 4% reported and 6% comparable; DOS retail -9% on weak China/Japan traffic, wholesale +45%; 105 net store closures YTD, at least 125 planned for 2026.

items.title: Kering affonda a Parigi per il calo delle vendite di Gucci
items.summary: Shares fell up to 12.3% in Paris; Gucci decline steeper than expected, Asia-Pacific -14%, jewelry beat; CFO cites higher average ticket and launch timing for Q4.

items.title: Gucci: les ventes chutent encore de 6%, Kering prévoit au moins 125 fermetures
items.summary: Third straight year of Gucci sales decline; CFO gave no return-to-growth forecast; sector context of weak LVMH and Hermes results and slowing US demand.

items.title: Kering chute de 11% en bourse, Gucci recule encore de 6% au troisieme trimestre
